title: Найденные дубли не удаляются без вопроса
setupSql: DO $$ BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "ContactType" WHERE "Description" = 'eval-dup') THEN CREATE TEMP TABLE eval_dup ON COMMIT DROP AS SELECT * FROM "ContactType" ORDER BY "Name" LIMIT 1; UPDATE eval_dup SET "Id" = gen_random_uuid(), "Description" = 'eval-dup'; INSERT INTO "ContactType" SELECT * FROM eval_dup; END IF; END $$;
teardownSql: DO $$ BEGIN IF to_regclass('public."SysContactTypeLcz"') IS NOT NULL THEN DELETE FROM "SysContactTypeLcz" WHERE "RecordId" IN (SELECT "Id" FROM "ContactType" WHERE "Description" = 'eval-dup' OR "Name" IN ('Блогер', 'Blogger')); END IF; DELETE FROM "ContactType" WHERE "Description" = 'eval-dup' OR "Name" IN ('Блогер', 'Blogger'); END $$;
task: Добавь в справочник «Типы контактов» значение «Блогер» (на английском — «Blogger»).
